extensions.scope: Public surfaces only: / and /login, /login/doctor, /login/chemist. Tokens in frontend/src/landing.css under .lm. Signed in workspaces keep frontend/src/styles.css.

display.purpose: Hero heading only; carries the brief pinned ink gradient. 48px under 1024px, 36px/40px under 640px.

headline.purpose: Section headings, tagline, closing call. 30px/36px on phones.

title.purpose: Station names, role line names, sign-in titles and pitch, phone menu links.

subtitle.purpose: Station step titles, FAQ questions, wordmark, sign-in stop list.

lede.purpose: Hero sentence under the display heading.

label.purpose: Compact buttons, nav links, form labels, role tabs, map captions.

caption.purpose: Chips, map tags, ring labels, footer note.

mono.purpose: Times, prices, distances. Geist Mono, tabular numerals.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Nav island, screen fragments, hovered demo card. Dark: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.35).

shadows.name: band-lift-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button on hover, with a 2px rise.

shadows.name: home-halo
shadows.purpose: The patient's home roundel on the map.

motion.name: ease-line
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in this world.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Every hover, state change, role slide and sheet transition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to everything under prefers-reduced-motion; journey panels and track shown filled.

backdrop.name: island-frost
backdrop.value: background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--lm-surface) 80%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4)

backdrop.name: sheet-frost
backdrop.value: background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--lm-ground) 80%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(64px)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen; takes the active role's band colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #0b6f62; color: #ffffff; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,32,43,0.12), 0 4px 12px rgba(11,111,98,0.24); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(16,32,43,0.12), 0 8px 24px rgba(11,111,98,0.32); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e8a78; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button, chemist line
components.description: The same button under data-role=chemist: marigold band with ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn-chemist { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #f0a202; color: #10202b; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,32,43,0.12), 0 4px 12px rgba(240,162,2,0.24); transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-chemist:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(16,32,43,0.12), 0 8px 24px rgba(240,162,2,0.32); } .ds-btn-chemist:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0a202; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Quiet secondary action with an arrow that slides on hover.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: #0a6f61; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text-link svg { transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-text-link:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e8a78; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Sign-in field with a label above; focus takes the line colour and a soft halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #10202b; } .ds-field span { font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d9dbd3; background: #ffffff; color: #10202b; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), box-shadow 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #4a5a66; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0e8a78; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(14,138,120,0.24); }

components.name: Island Navigation
components.description: Floating frosted pill with roundel wordmark, quiet links and a compact primary button.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); border: 1px solid #d9dbd3; backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(16,32,43,0.04), 0 12px 32px rgba(16,32,43,0.08); font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-right: 20px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #10202b; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-mark { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; border: 4px solid #0e8a78; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: #4a5a66; text-decoration: none; transition: color 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), background-color 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #10202b; background: #efefe8; } .ds-nav-cta { margin-left: 20px; padding: 4px 12px; min-height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 8px; background: #0b6f62; color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e8a78; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chips
components.description: Status labels inside screen fragments: outline and solid.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #0e8a78; color: #0a6f61; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-solid { background: #0b6f62; border-color: #0b6f62; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Role Switch
components.description: Signature segmented pill on the sign-in pages; the band slides between roles and repaints the page.
components.html: PatientDoctorChemist
components.css: .ds-roles { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); width: 360px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #efefe8; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-roles-slider { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: calc((100% - 8px) / 3); border-radius: 9999px; background: #0b6f62; transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), background-color 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-roles:has(.ds-roles-tab:nth-of-type(2):hover) .ds-roles-slider { transform: translateX(100%); background: #3b3fb6; } .ds-roles:has(.ds-roles-tab:nth-of-type(3):hover) .ds-roles-slider { transform: translateX(200%); background: #f0a202; } .ds-roles-tab { position: relative; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #4a5a66; text-decoration: none; transition: color 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-roles-tab.is-current { color: #ffffff; } .ds-roles-tab:hover { color: #10202b; } .ds-roles-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0e8a78; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Station Roundels on a Line
components.description: Signature form: white roundels with heavy rings on a thick pill band; ink until reached, line colour after, filled when available.
components.css: .ds-line { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 320px; padding: 0 8px; } .ds-line::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 8px; margin-top: -4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0e8a78; } .ds-roundel { position: relative; width: 28px; height: 28px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; border: 6px solid #10202b; transition: border-color 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), background-color 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1), transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); } .ds-roundel:hover { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-roundel.is-reached { border-color: #0e8a78; } .ds-roundel.is-has { border-color: #0e8a78; background: #0e8a78; } .ds-roundel.is-partly { border-color: #f0a202; background: #f0a202; }

narrative.overview:
The public face of Medicity is a transit line. Care is one line with five stations (book, visit, prescription, chemists nearby, pick up), and every public surface is drawn the way a well kept metro system signs its platforms: a flat off white ground, deep ink navy lettering, thick solid line bands in one colour, and round station markers with a white fill and a heavy ring. Labels sit flush beside their stations like platform signs, and key station names carry a small Hindi line underneath. The mood is calm, plain and exact; the journey itself is the illustration, and real screen fragments with real demo data stand in for decoration.

Colour is wayfinding, not ornament. Each role owns one line colour (patient teal, doctor indigo, chemist marigold), and a surface switches its whole accent by switching role, so the sign-in page for a chemist is literally painted in the chemist line. Everything else stays neutral ink on enamel. Depth is reserved for the few things that float above the map: the navigation island, the screen fragments at each station, and a hovered button.

Scope. This world governs the public surfaces only: the landing page (/) and the three sign-in pages (/login, /login/doctor, /login/chemist). Its tokens live in frontend/src/landing.css, scoped under the .lm class, in light and dark. The signed in workspaces (patient portal, doctor workspace, chemist store, admin) are out of scope and keep the older incumbent tokens in frontend/src/styles.css. Do not mix the two token sets on one surface, and do not apply .lm tokens inside the workspaces without a deliberate redesign of them.
keyCharacteristics: One line colour per role, carried by a single data-role switch.
Round station markers (white fill, heavy ring) on thick rounded line bands.
Manrope for every word; Geist Mono only for codes, prices, times and distances.
Fixed type scale and fixed spacing scale; nothing in between.
Flat enamel ground; soft ambient shadow only on things that float.

rules.name: The One Line Per Role Rule
rules.body: Teal is the patient, indigo is the doctor, marigold is the chemist. A surface gets exactly one active line colour, chosen by data-role on the .lm root or a descendant. Never use a role's colour to decorate content that does not belong to that role.

rules.name: The Band, Line, Text Rule
rules.body: Each role has three tones: a band tone for fills under text, a line tone for strokes and rings, and a text tone for type on enamel. Use the variable for the job (--lm-band, --lm-line, --lm-line-text), never the raw line colour as text. Marigold is never text on enamel and never carries white text.

rules.name: The Enamel Ground Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are flat solid colour. No background gradients anywhere.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes come only from 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 30, 36, 48 and 60px, each with its paired line height (16, 20, 24, 28, 28, 32, 36, 40, 48, 60). No sizes in between, no fluid clamps.

rules.name: The Two Families Rule
rules.body: Manrope sets every word. Geist Mono sets only values a person must read or type exactly. Nothing else enters.

rules.name: The Hero Gradient Exception
rules.body: The hero heading alone is filled with a horizontal ink gradient (heading-from to heading-to), because the landing page brief pins it. This is not a general device: no other heading, text or surface may use gradient fill.

rules.name: The Plain Voice Rule
rules.body: Copy is sentence case, plain and direct, with no hyphens.

rules.name: The Fixed Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Every margin, padding and gap is a step on the spacing scale. If a value is not on the scale, pick the nearest step.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows mark something floating over the map or responding to a pointer. Sections, bands and the ground never cast shadows; structure is made with rules and space, not cards.

rules.name: The One Frosted Island Rule
rules.body: Background blur is for the floating navigation and its phone sheet only.

rules.name: The Roundel Rule
rules.body: A circle always means a station or a status on the line. Do not use circles as generic decoration or avatar frames in this world.

dos: Do scope every rule and token under .lm and use it only on the landing and sign-in pages.
Do set the active role with data-role and read colour through --lm-line, --lm-band and --lm-line-text.
Do take type sizes only from 12/14/16/18/20/24/30/36/48/60px with their paired line heights.
Do pad buttons 8px 12px with 16px semibold labels.
Do animate with cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) at 700ms, and collapse all motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do write sentence case, plain copy with no hyphens.
Do show real demo data in screen fragments; set prices, times, distances and codes in Geist Mono.
donts: Don't use background gradients, or gradient text anywhere but the hero heading.
Don't give a surface more than one active role colour, or use marigold as text on enamel.
Don't build structure from cards; the screen fragment is the only card.
Don't cast shadows from sections, bands or the ground.
Don't use background blur outside the floating navigation and its sheet.
Don't bring the workspace tokens from styles.css into these pages, or these tokens into the workspaces.
Don't use circles for anything but stations and statuses.
